# Data

## Load 

Sur BDOH les chroniques de débit et MES sont disponibles jusqu'à 2019. Données 2020-2021 fournies par Ophélie. 

Vérifier l'unité de "period"


```{r load-data}
crues <- readxl::read_xlsx(path = "galabre.xlsx", sheet = "Crues") 

mes <- readxl::read_xlsx(path = "galabre.xlsx", sheet = "SSC", col_types = c("date","numeric")) 

debit <- readxl::read_xlsx(path = "galabre.xlsx", sheet = "Debit", col_types = c("date","numeric")) 

galabre_old <- merge(debit, mes, by = "DateHeure") %>% unique() # 4 duplicated in 2017, no q

galabre_new <- readxl::read_xlsx(path = "Galabre_outlet.xlsx", sheet = "Galabre_outlet_noduplicated") %>% unique() # 2019 was duplicated (also in galabre_old). Some duplicated still exist, removed by "unique"

galabre_tot <- rbind(galabre_old, galabre_new)

#galabre_tot[which(duplicated(galabre_tot$DateHeure) == T), ] %>% View()

galabre <- merge(galabre_tot, crues, by = "DateHeure", all = T)  
galabre$year <- year(galabre$DateHeure)
galabre$commondate <- as.Date(paste0("2000-", format(galabre$DateHeure,"%j")), "%Y-%j")
galabre$period <- as.numeric(-(galabre$DateHeure - lead(galabre$DateHeure))) # period in s

# from galabre

summary_galabre <- merge(
galabre %>% subset(!is.na(poc_percent)) %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise(nb_poc = n()),
galabre %>% subset(!is.na(cmes_g.L)) %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise(nb_cmes = n()),
by = "year", all = T) %>% 
  merge(galabre %>% subset(!is.na(q_m3.s)) %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise(nb_q = n()), by = "year", all = T) %>%
  merge(galabre %>% subset(!is.na(q_m3.s)) %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise(period_q = round(n()*10/(24*60),0)), by = "year", all = T) 


summary_galabre %>% knitr::kable(caption = "Nombre d'observations de DOC, POC, CMES et débit par an") %>% kableExtra::kable_styling()

complete_years <- c(2009:2014)

```

`

# Fit MES-POC

Objectif: construire la relation MES-POC pour pouvoir reconstruire la chronique de POC à partir de la chronique de MES. Cette relation prend la forme de $POC\% = a*MES^b + c$. Le modèle est fitté sur les données de crues dont la concentration en POC a été mesurée: **poc_galabre**.

```{r poc-galabre}
poc_galabre <- galabre %>% filter(!is.na(poc_percent) & !is.na(mes_g.L) & mes_g.L != 0) # one missing value for MES, one MES = 0

poc_galabre$mes_for_fit <- poc_galabre$mes_g.L 

n_obs <- nrow(poc_galabre)
n_boot <- 1000
```


```{r uncertainties}
q_u <- 0.1 # vérifier chiffre galabre
mes_u <- 0.05 # au pif
```

On cherche à fitter le modèle $POC (prop) = a \* MES^{b} + aspt$. Deux fonctions R sont disponibles : *nls* et *gnls*. nls est robuste, mais gnls permet de choisir la structure de la variance. On sait que la variance diminue pour les hautes valeurs de MES (on tend vers l'asymptote). L'erreur dépend probablement de $y*\sigma^{2\delta}.

```{r asymptot}
# find asymptotic value : arbitrarily decide that it corresponds to the median of the 10% of poc_percent corresponding to the 10% of highest MES values.
aspt_value <- poc_galabre[order(poc_galabre$cmes_g.L, decreasing = T),] %>% pull(poc_percent) %>% head(dim(poc_galabre)[1]/10) %>% mean() 
aspt_value_sd <- poc_galabre[order(poc_galabre$cmes_g.L, decreasing = T),] %>% pull(poc_percent) %>% head(dim(poc_galabre)[1]/10) %>% sd() 

poc_galabre$aspt <- aspt_value
```

## Log-log linear regression: get starting values


```{r lm-poc-mes}
pocfit <- lm(log(poc_percent)~log(mes_for_fit), data = select(poc_galabre, c(poc_percent, mes_for_fit)))

summary(pocfit)
```


## GNLS with aspt 

### Fit GNLS model 

```{r fit-poc-mes-gnls}

# fit gnls
pocfitg <- gnls(
  poc_percent ~ a*mes_for_fit^b + aspt,
  data = select(poc_galabre, c(mes_for_fit, poc_percent, aspt)),
  start = list(a = coef(pocfit)[[2]], b = coef(pocfit)[[1]]), # on utilise les valeurs de pocfit comme coefficients initiaux
  weights = varPower(value = 1, form = ~ fitted(.)),
  control = gnlsControl(nlsTol = 1e-3, tolerance = 1e-4)
)

# summary 
summary(pocfitg) %>% print()

# variance parameters
theta <- as.numeric(coef(pocfitg$modelStruct$varStruct, unconstrained = F))
sigma_gnls <- pocfitg$sigma

# formula
formula_pocfitg <- paste("GNLS:", round(coef(pocfitg)[1], 3), "x MES ^", round(coef(pocfitg)[2],3), "+", round(aspt_value, 3), sep = "")

## model function 
f <- function(x, a, b, aspt){
  a * x ^ b + aspt
}
```


### GNLS bootstrap

```{r intervalles-de-confiance-bootstrap}

coefs_boot <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_boot, ncol = 2, dimnames = list(NULL, c("a","b")))
                     

for(i in seq_len(n_boot)){
  
  idx_boot <- sample(n_obs, replace = T)
  df_boot <- poc_galabre[idx_boot, c("mes_for_fit","poc_percent","aspt")]
  
  tryCatch(
    {fit_init <- nls(
      poc_percent ~ a * mes_for_fit^b + aspt,
      data = df_boot,
      start = coef(pocfitg))
      # fit init is necessary to find the correct starting values for gnls. Otherwise, too much convergence result in extreme values in a and b

      pocfit_bg <- gnls(
      poc_percent~a*mes_for_fit^b+aspt,
      data = df_boot,
      start = coef(fit_init),
      weights = varPower(form = ~fitted(.)),
      control = gnlsControl(nlsTol = 1e-3, tolerance = 1e-4, maxIter = 200))
      
      coefs_boot[i,] <- coef(pocfit_bg)
      }, 
    error = function(e) NULL) 
}

# removes NA
coefs_boot <- na.omit(coefs_boot)
apply(coefs_boot, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)) %>% knitr::kable() #ic coef
ggplot(as.data.frame(coefs_boot))+
  geom_point(aes(x = a, y = b))+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# adds uncertainty around aspt
coefs_boot <- cbind(coefs_boot, "aspt" = rnorm(length(coefs_boot)/2, mean = aspt_value, sd = aspt_value_sd))

# compute POC
fitted_boot <- apply(coefs_boot, 1, function(p){p["a"] * poc_galabre$mes_for_fit^p["b"] + p["aspt"]}) # MC worlds in columns
fitted_boot_ic <- apply(fitted_boot, 1, quantile, 
                 probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE) # prediction intervals
fitted_boot_mean <- apply(fitted_boot, 1, mean) # meet bottstrapped valur

# intergrates in poc_galabre
poc_galabre_boot_gnls <- poc_galabre %>% mutate(poc_fitted = fitted_boot_mean, upr = fitted_boot_ic[3, ], lwr = fitted_boot_ic[1,])

ggplot(poc_galabre_boot_gnls)+
  geom_point(aes(x=mes_for_fit, y = poc_percent, col = "measured", shape = "measured"))+ 
  geom_point(aes(x=mes_for_fit, y = poc_fitted, col = "fitted", shape = "fitted"))+ 
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = mes_for_fit, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept = aspt_value, col = "darkred")+
  annotate(geom = "label", label = formula_pocfitg, x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkblue", "lightblue"))+
  labs(x = "MES, mg/L", y = "POC, %", colour = "", shape = "", title = "POC% measured and fitted vs MES measured",subtitle = "Confidence interval in grey")+
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(poc_galabre_boot_gnls, aes(x=poc_percent))+
  geom_point(aes(y=poc_fitted), col = "darkblue")+ 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, col = "darkred")+
  annotate(geom = "label", label = formula_pocfitg, x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1)+
  labs(x = "POC measured", y = "POC fitted", colour = "", shape = "", title = "POC fitted vs measured",subtitle = "Confidence interval in grey")+
  theme_minimal()
```


### GNLS extension to galabre

**mes_for_fit** contient beaucoup de zéros (462553). Ils ne peuvent pas être inclus dans le modèle parce qu'il est instable avec 0^(-b). On va fitter les autres lignes et imposer POC% = 0 pour les lignes où MES = 0. 

Pour la méthode, on utilise uniquement les années où les chroniques de débit sont complètes... de 2009 à 2014. 

```{r constant-numbers}
# prepare dataframe
galabre_gnls <- galabre %>% filter(year %in% complete_years)
galabre_gnls$mes_for_fit <- galabre_gnls$cmes_g.L
with(galabre_gnls, sum(mes_for_fit == 0 | is.na(mes_for_fit), na.rm = T)) # 291686

na_lines <- which(is.na(galabre_gnls$mes_for_fit)) # 0
zero_lines <- which(galabre_gnls$mes_for_fit == 0)
fit_lines <- which(galabre_gnls$mes_for_fit != 0 & !is.na(galabre_gnls$mes_for_fit))

galabre_pwl_gnls <- galabre_gnls[fit_lines, ]
galabre_pwl_gnls$aspt <- aspt_value # from nls fitting

nrow_boot <- nrow(coefs_boot)
nrow_galabre_gnls <- nrow(galabre_gnls)
```


```{r pred-galabre-gnls, cache.lazy = F}

# predict POC pour mes > 0
poc_fitted <- predict(pocfitg, newdata = galabre_pwl_gnls, na.action = na.pass)
galabre_gnls$poc_fitted <- NA
galabre_gnls[fit_lines, ]$poc_fitted <- poc_fitted
galabre_gnls[zero_lines, ]$poc_fitted <- 0


# MES matrix
mes_meas <- matrix(galabre_gnls$mes_for_fit, nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_galabre_gnls, byrow = T) # repeats nrow_boot times the vector isere_for_gnls$q_m3.s
mes_noise <- matrix(rnorm(nrow_boot*nrow_galabre_gnls, mean = 0, sd = mes_u), nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_galabre_gnls) # 
mes_mat <- mes_meas * (1 + mes_noise) # final value of q, with noise. 


# Prediction matrix, no model noise
mu_gnls <- f(mes_mat, coefs_boot[,"a"], coefs_boot[,"b"], coefs_boot[,"aspt"])

# Prediction matrix, with noise
noise_mat_gnls <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_galabre_gnls)
sigma_mat_gnls <- sigma_gnls * abs(mu_gnls)^theta # variance depends on predicted value

noise_mat_gnls <- matrix(rnorm(nrow_boot*nrow_galabre_gnls, mean = 0, sd = 1), nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_galabre_gnls)
noise_mat_gnls <- noise_mat_gnls*sigma_mat_gnls

pred_gnls <- mu_gnls + noise_mat_gnls
pred_gnls[,zero_lines] <- 0
pred_gnls <- pmin(pmax(pred_gnls, 0), 100) # clampe pred_nls pour éviter les intervalles de prédiction en dessous de zéro et au dessus de 100 (no case)

# Prediction interval 
pi <- t(apply(pred_gnls, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = T))
colnames(pi) <- c("lower", "upper")

# Mean bootstrap value
boot_pred_gnls <- colMeans(pred_gnls, na.rm = T)

## insert in galabre_for_gnls
galabre_gnls <- galabre_gnls %>% mutate(poc_boot_pred = boot_pred_gnls,
                          poc_pred_lower = pi[,1],
                          poc_pred_upper = pi[,2])

# variances
galabre_gnls$poc_var_mean <- apply(mu_gnls, 2, var) # variance of fit parameters + MES 
galabre_gnls$poc_var_tot <- apply(pred_gnls, 2, var) # total variance per prediction, for prediction total uncertainty

# plot
ggplot(galabre_gnls, aes(x = mes_for_fit))+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_pred_lower, ymax = poc_pred_upper), col = "gray50")+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_pred_upper), col = "gray50")+
  geom_point(aes(y = poc_percent, col = "measured"), alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5)+
  geom_point(aes(y = poc_fitted, col = "fitted with all events"), size = 2)+
  geom_point(aes(y = poc_boot_pred, col ="poc_boot_pred"), alpha = 0.5, size = 1)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkblue","gray50","lightblue"))+
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept = aspt_value, col = "darkred")+
  annotate(geom = "label", label = formula_pocfitg, x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1)+
  labs(x = "MES, mg/L", y = "POC, %", colour = "", shape = "", title = "POC predicted from MES",subtitle = "Prediction interval in grey")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# plot variance
ggplot(galabre_gnls, aes(x = mes_for_fit))+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_var_mean, col = "model variance"))+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_var_tot, col = "total variance (includes noise)"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("lightblue", "darkblue"))+
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log", breaks = c(0.01,0.1,1,10,50))+
  labs(x = "MES, g/L", y = "variance")+
  theme_minimal()
    
```

## No aspt

### Fit GNLS model 

```{r fit-poc-mes-gnls-nas}

# fit gnls
pocfitg_nas <- gnls(
  poc_percent ~ a*mes_for_fit^b,
  data = select(poc_galabre, c(mes_for_fit, poc_percent)),
  start = list(a = coef(pocfit)[[2]], b = coef(pocfit)[[1]]), # on utilise les valeurs de pocfit comme coefficients initiaux
  weights = varPower(value = 1, form = ~ fitted(.)),
  control = gnlsControl(nlsTol = 1e-3, tolerance = 1e-4)
)

# summary 
summary(pocfitg_nas) %>% print()

# variance parameters
theta_nas <- as.numeric(coef(pocfitg_nas$modelStruct$varStruct, unconstrained = F))
sigma_gnls_nas <- pocfitg_nas$sigma

# formula
formula_pocfitg_nas <- paste("GNLS:", round(coef(pocfitg_nas)[1], 3), "x MES ^", round(coef(pocfitg_nas)[2],3), "+", round(aspt_value, 3), sep = "")

## model function 
f <- function(x, a, b){
  a * x ^ b
}
```


### GNLS bootstrap

```{r intervalles-de-confiance-bootstrap-nas}

coefs_boot_nas <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_boot, ncol = 2, dimnames = list(NULL, c("a","b")))
                     

for(i in seq_len(n_boot)){
  
  idx_boot <- sample(n_obs, replace = T)
  df_boot <- poc_galabre[idx_boot, c("mes_for_fit","poc_percent")]
  
  tryCatch(
    {fit_init <- nls(
      poc_percent ~ a * mes_for_fit^b,
      data = df_boot,
      start = coef(pocfitg_nas))
      # fit init is necessary to find the correct starting values for gnls. Otherwise, too much convergence result in extreme values in a and b

      pocfit_bg <- gnls(
      poc_percent~a*mes_for_fit^b,
      data = df_boot,
      start = coef(fit_init),
      weights = varPower(form = ~fitted(.)),
      control = gnlsControl(nlsTol = 1e-3, tolerance = 1e-4, maxIter = 200))
      
      coefs_boot_nas[i,] <- coef(pocfit_bg)
      }, 
    error = function(e) NULL) 
}

# removes NA
coefs_boot_nas <- na.omit(coefs_boot_nas)
apply(coefs_boot_nas, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)) %>% knitr::kable() #ic coef
ggplot(as.data.frame(coefs_boot_nas))+
  geom_point(aes(x = a, y = b))+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position = "none")


# compute POC
fitted_boot_nas <- apply(coefs_boot_nas, 1, function(p){p["a"] * poc_galabre$mes_for_fit^p["b"]}) # MC worlds in columns
fitted_boot_nas_ic <- apply(fitted_boot_nas, 1, quantile, 
                 probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE) # prediction intervals
fitted_boot__nasmean <- apply(fitted_boot_nas, 1, mean) # meet bottstrapped valur

# intergrates in poc_galabre
poc_galabre_boot_gnls_nas <- poc_galabre %>% mutate(poc_fitted = fitted_boot__nasmean, upr = fitted_boot_nas_ic[3, ], lwr = fitted_boot_nas_ic[1,])

ggplot(poc_galabre_boot_gnls_nas)+
  geom_point(aes(x=mes_for_fit, y = poc_percent, col = "measured", shape = "measured"))+ 
  geom_point(aes(x=mes_for_fit, y = poc_fitted, col = "fitted", shape = "fitted"))+ 
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = mes_for_fit, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept = aspt_value, col = "darkred")+
  annotate(geom = "label", label = formula_pocfitg_nas, x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkblue", "lightblue"))+
  labs(x = "MES, mg/L", y = "POC, %", colour = "", shape = "", title = "POC% measured and fitted vs MES measured",subtitle = "Confidence interval in grey")+
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(poc_galabre_boot_gnls_nas, aes(x=poc_percent))+
  geom_point(aes(y=poc_fitted), col = "darkblue")+ 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, col = "darkred")+
  annotate(geom = "label", label = formula_pocfitg, x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1)+
  labs(x = "POC measured", y = "POC fitted", colour = "", shape = "", title = "POC fitted vs measured",subtitle = "Confidence interval in grey")+
  theme_minimal()
```


### GNLS extension to galabre

**mes_for_fit** contient beaucoup de zéros. Ils ne peuvent pas être inclus dans le modèle parce qu'il est instable avec 0^(-b). On va fitter les autres lignes et imposer POC% = 0 pour les lignes où MES = 0

```{r constant-numbers-nas}
# prepare dataframe
galabre_nas <- galabre %>% filter(year %in% complete_years)
galabre_nas$mes_for_fit <- galabre_nas$cmes_g.L
with(galabre_nas, sum(mes_for_fit == 0 | is.na(mes_for_fit), na.rm = T)) # 462553

na_lines <- which(is.na(galabre_nas$mes_for_fit)) # 0
zero_lines <- which(galabre_nas$mes_for_fit == 0)
fit_lines <- which(galabre_nas$mes_for_fit != 0 & !is.na(galabre_nas$mes_for_fit))

galabre_nas_pwl <- galabre_nas[fit_lines, ]
galabre_nas_pwl$aspt <- aspt_value # from nls fitting

nrow_boot <- nrow(coefs_boot_nas)
nrow_galabre_nas <- nrow(galabre_nas)
```


```{r pred-galabre-gnls-nas, cache.lazy = F}

# predict POC pour mes > 0
poc_fitted_nas <- predict(pocfitg_nas, newdata = galabre_nas_pwl, na.action = na.pass)
galabre_nas$poc_fitted <- NA
galabre_nas[fit_lines, ]$poc_fitted <- poc_fitted_nas
galabre_nas[zero_lines, ]$poc_fitted <- 0


# MES matrix
mes_meas <- matrix(galabre_nas$mes_for_fit, nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_galabre_nas, byrow = T) # repeats nrow_boot times the vector isere_for_gnls$q_m3.s
mes_noise <- matrix(rnorm(nrow_boot*nrow_galabre_nas, mean = 0, sd = mes_u), nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_galabre_nas) # 
mes_mat <- mes_meas * (1 + mes_noise) # final value of q, with noise. 


# Prediction matrix, no model noise
mu_gnls <- f(mes_mat, coefs_boot_nas[,"a"], coefs_boot_nas[,"b"])


# Prediction matrix, with noise
noise_mat_gnls <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_galabre_nas)
sigma_mat_gnls <- sigma_gnls_nas * abs(mu_gnls)^theta_nas # variance depends on predicted value

noise_mat_gnls <- matrix(rnorm(nrow_boot*nrow_galabre_nas, mean = 0, sd = 1), nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_galabre_nas)
noise_mat_gnls <- noise_mat_gnls*sigma_mat_gnls

pred_gnls <- mu_gnls + noise_mat_gnls
pred_gnls[,zero_lines] <- 0

pred_gnls <- pmin(pmax(pred_gnls, 0), 100) # clampe pred_nls pour éviter les intervalles de prédiction en dessous de zéro (et au dessus de 100, mais on ne devrait pas avoir ce cas) 

# Prediction interval 
pi <- t(apply(pred_gnls, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = T))
colnames(pi) <- c("lower", "upper")

# Mean bootstrap value
boot_pred_gnls <- colMeans(pred_gnls, na.rm = T)

## insert in galabre_nas
galabre_nas <- galabre_nas %>% mutate(poc_boot_pred = boot_pred_gnls,
                          poc_pred_lower = pi[,1],
                          poc_pred_upper = pi[,2])

# variances
galabre_nas$poc_var_mean <- apply(mu_gnls, 2, var) # variance of fit parameters + MES 
galabre_nas$poc_var_tot <- apply(pred_gnls, 2, var) # total variance per prediction, for prediction total uncertainty

# plot
ggplot(galabre_nas, aes(x = mes_for_fit))+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_pred_lower), col = "gray50")+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_pred_upper), col = "gray50")+
  geom_point(aes(y = poc_percent, col = "measured"), alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5)+
  geom_point(aes(y = poc_fitted, col = "fitted with all events"), size = 2)+
  geom_point(aes(y = poc_boot_pred, col ="poc_boot_pred"), alpha = 0.5, size = 1)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkblue","gray50","lightblue"))+
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept = aspt_value, col = "darkred")+
  annotate(geom = "label", label = formula_pocfitg_nas, x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1)+
  labs(x = "MES, mg/L", y = "POC, %", colour = "", shape = "", title = "POC predicted from MES",subtitle = "Prediction interval in grey")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# plot variance
ggplot(galabre_nas, aes(x = mes_for_fit))+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_var_mean, col = "model variance"))+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_var_tot, col = "total variance (includes noise)"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("lightblue", "darkblue"))+
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log", breaks = c(0.01,0.1,1,10,50))+
  labs(x = "MES, g/L", y = "variance")+
  theme_minimal()
    
```


# Reference annual and interannual fluxes 

## Annual flux based on gnls model + Monte Carlo


```{r annual-flux-reference, cache.lazy=F}
# create matrix of q
q_meas <- matrix(galabre_nas$q_m3.s, nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_galabre_nas, byrow = T) # repeats nrow_boot times the vector galabre_nas$q_m3.s
q_noise <- matrix(rnorm(nrow_boot*nrow_galabre_nas, mean = 0, sd = q_u), nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_galabre_nas) # creates a noise in percent (proportion), between 0 and 10%
q_mat <- q_meas * (1 + q_noise) # final value of q, with noise


# matrix of period (no uncertainty,tge same repeated nrow_boot times)
galabre_nas$period <- as.numeric(-(galabre_nas$DateHeure - lead(galabre_nas$DateHeure))) # period in s, updated for remaining lines
period_mat <- matrix(galabre_nas$period, nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_galabre_nas, byrow = T)

# Instant flux matrix
flux_kg.s_mat <- pred_gnls*mes_mat*1e-6*q_mat*1e-2*10*60 #pred_gnls * mes_mat : poc in g/L converted to ton/L; q_mat converted from m3/s to L/s. We consider no uncertainty on period, that is uniformely 10 minutes. 

# Get index for the columns corresponding to the same year
index_years <- sapply(unique(galabre_nas$year), function(y){which(galabre_nas$year == y)}) # list of indices corresponding to each year

# Annual flux
annual_flux_ton.y <- sapply(index_years, function(idx){apply(flux_kg.s_mat[,idx], 1, sum, na.rm = T)}) # sum of fluxes per year, for each iteration of the bootstrap. Result is a matrix with nrow_boot rows and 19 columns (1 per year)
annual_flux_pi <- apply(annual_flux_ton.y, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = T) # prediction interval for annual fluxes, per year. 3 lignes, 19 columns
annual_flux_mean <- colMeans(annual_flux_ton.y, na.rm = T) # mean annual flux per year. 1 vector
annual_flux_sd <- apply(annual_flux_ton.y, 2, sd, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of annual flux per year. Is just an estimate of goodness of mean, not as good as than the confidence interval. 

# Merge in df
annual_flux_df <- data.frame(year = unique(galabre_nas$year), 
                        annual_flux_mean = annual_flux_mean, 
                        annual_flux_variability = annual_flux_sd, 
                        annual_flux_pi_lower = annual_flux_pi[1,], 
                        annual_flux_pi_upper = annual_flux_pi[3,])
# Plot
ggplot(annual_flux_df)+
  geom_col(aes(x=year, y = annual_flux_mean), fill = "lightblue")+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_pi_lower, ymax = annual_flux_pi_upper), width = 0.2)+
  labs(title = "Mean annual flux with prediction interval", x = "", y = "Mean annual flux, ton")+
  theme_minimal()
```

## Interannual flux

```{r interannual-flux-reference}
interannual_flux_ton.y <- rowMeans(annual_flux_ton.y, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux per iteration of the bootstrap
interannual_flux_pi <- quantile(interannual_flux_ton.y, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = T) # prediction interval
interannual_flux_mean <- mean(interannual_flux_ton.y, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux
interannual_flux_variability <- sd(annual_flux_mean, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of interannual flux per year

interannual_flux_df <- data.frame(year = "interannual", annual_flux_mean = interannual_flux_mean, 
                                  annual_flux_variability = interannual_flux_variability,
                        annual_flux_pi_lower = interannual_flux_pi[1], 
                        annual_flux_pi_upper = interannual_flux_pi[3])

total_flux_df <- rbind(annual_flux_df, interannual_flux_df)
total_flux_df$group <- c(rep("annual", length(unique(galabre_nas$year))), "interannual")

ggplot()+
  geom_col(data = total_flux_df, aes(x=year, y = annual_flux_mean, fill = group))+
    geom_errorbar(data = total_flux_df, aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_pi_lower, ymax = annual_flux_pi_upper, col = "prediction interval"), width = 0.3, size = 0.8)+
  geom_errorbar(data = filter(total_flux_df, year == "interannual"), aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_mean - annual_flux_variability, ymax = annual_flux_mean + annual_flux_variability, col = "interannual variability"), width = 0.2, size = 0.8, linetype = 2)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("annual" = "lightblue", "interannual" = "indianred"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("prediction interval" = "darkblue", "interannual variability" = "darkred"), name = "")+
   labs(x = "Year", y = "Flux (kg/year)", fill = "")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
```

# Time steps

Time step for CMES and Q: 10 min 

```{r common-data}
galabre_time <- galabre %>% filter(!is.na(mes_for_fit))

mes_u <- 0.05
q_u <- 0.05

set.seed(2502)

library(future.apply)
plan(multisession, workers = 6)
```


Random CMES over timer period: mean Q, then GNLS. 

## 2-Hour

```{r pred-galabre-gnls-hour2, cache.lazy = F}
# prepare df
galabre_group_hour2 <- galabre_time %>% 
  mutate(day = format(DateHeure, "%Y-%m-%d"), 
         year = year(DateHeure),
         hour2 =  floor(hour(DateHeure) / 2) * 2, # creates a 2-hours interval
         DateHeure = NULL) %>% group_by(hour2,day,year) # group galabre_time by hour
nrow_hour2 <- n_groups(galabre_group_hour2)

# get mean q
q_hour2 <- galabre_group_hour2 %>% select(c("hour2", "q_m3.s")) %>% summarize_all(list("q_mean" = mean, "q_sd" = sd)) %>% ungroup() # mean of Q for each hour2


# creates matrix for MES
galabre_mes_hour2 <- galabre_group_hour2 %>% select(c("hour2", "mes_for_fit")) %>% summarize("list_mes" = list(mes_for_fit)) %>% ungroup() # creates a list of mes for each hour2

list_mes_hour2 <- galabre_mes_hour2$list_mes
mes_hour2_random <- future_replicate(nrow_boot, vapply(list_mes_hour2, 
                                                function(x) sample(x,1), numeric(1)),
                              future.seed = T) %>% 
                    t() # matrix of mes: one random sample per hour2, replicated 1000 times

mes_hour2_noise <- matrix(rnorm(nrow_boot*nrow_hour2, mean = 0, sd = mes_u), nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_hour2) 
mes_mat_hour2 <- mes_hour2_random * (1 + mes_hour2_noise) # final value of mes, with noise

mes_mean <- colMeans(mes_mat_hour2)

# Prediction matrix
mu_hour2 <- f(mes_mat_hour2, coefs_boot[,"a"], coefs_boot[,"b"], coefs_boot[,"aspt"])


# Prediction matrix, with noise
noise_mat_hour2 <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_galabre)
sigma_mat_hour2 <- sigma_gnls * abs(mu_hour2)^theta

noise_mat_hour2 <- matrix(rnorm(nrow_boot*nrow_hour2, mean = 0, sd = 1), nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_hour2)
noise_mat_hour2 <- noise_mat_hour2*sigma_mat_hour2

pred_hour2 <- mu_hour2 + noise_mat_hour2
pred_hour2 <- pmin(pmax(pred_hour2, 0), 100) # clampe pred_nls pour éviter les intervalles de prédiction en dessous de zéro


## computes prediction interval 
pi_hour2 <- t(
  apply(pred_hour2, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = T)
)

colnames(pi_hour2) <- c("lower", "upper")

boot_pred_hour2 <- colMeans(pred_hour2, na.rm = T)

## insert in galabre_hour2
galabre_hour2 <- q_hour2 %>% mutate(
                          mes_for_fit = mes_mean, # keep name for "fitting model"predict" function
                          poc_boot_pred = boot_pred_hour2,
                          poc_pred_lower = pi_hour2[,"lower"],
                          poc_pred_upper = pi_hour2[,"upper"],
                          aspt = aspt_value)

galabre_hour2$poc_fitted <- predict(pocfitg, galabre_hour2)

# variance 
galabre_hour2$poc_var_mean <- apply(mu_hour2, 2, var) # variance of fit parameters + MES 
galabre_hour2$poc_var_tot <- apply(pred_hour2, 2, var) # total variance per prediction, for prediction total uncertainty


# plot

ggplot(galabre_hour2, aes(x = mes_for_fit))+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_pred_lower, ymax = poc_pred_upper), col = "gray50")+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_pred_upper), col = "gray50")+
  geom_point(aes(y = poc_fitted, col = "fitted with all events"), size = 2)+
  geom_point(aes(y = poc_boot_pred, col ="poc_boot_pred"), alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkblue","lightblue"))+
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept = aspt_value, col = "darkred")+
  annotate(geom = "label", label = formula_pocfitg, x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1)+
  labs(x = "MES, g/L", y = "POC %", colour = "", shape = "", title = "POC predicted from MES, random sampling every 2nd hour", subtitle = "Prediction interval in grey")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

```

```{r annual-flux-hour4, cache.lazy= F}
interannual_flux_mean_hour4 <- mean(interannual_flux_ton.y_hour4, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux
interannual_flux_variability_hour4 <- sd(annual_flux_hour4_mean, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of interannual flux per year

interannual_flux_hour4_df <- data.frame(year = "interannual", annual_flux_mean = interannual_flux_mean_hour4, 
                                  annual_flux_variability = interannual_flux_variability_hour4,
                        annual_flux_pi_lower = interannual_flux_pi_hour4[1], 
                        annual_flux_pi_upper = interannual_flux_pi_hour4[3])

total_flux_hour4_df <- rbind(annual_flux_hour4_df, interannual_flux_hour4_df)
total_flux_hour4_df$group <- c(rep("annual", length(unique(galabre_hour4$year))), "interannual")

ggplot()+
  geom_col(data = total_flux_hour4_df, 
           aes(x=year, y = annual_flux_mean, fill = group))+
  geom_errorbar(data = total_flux_hour4_df, 
                aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_pi_lower, ymax = annual_flux_pi_upper, col = "prediction interval"),
                width = 0.3, size = 0.8)+
  geom_errorbar(data = filter(total_flux_hour4_df, year == "interannual"), 
                aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_mean - annual_flux_variability, 
                    ymax = annual_flux_mean + annual_flux_variability, col = "interannual variability"),
                width = 0.2, size = 0.8, linetype = 2)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("annual" = "lightblue", "interannual" = "indianred"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("prediction interval" = "darkblue", "interannual variability" = "darkred"), name = "")+
   labs(x = "Year", y = "Flux, from 4-hourly mean values (ton/year)", fill = "")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
```

## 8-Hour

```{r pred-galabre-gnls-hour8, cache.lazy = F}
# prepare df
galabre_group_hour8 <- galabre_time %>% 
  mutate(day = format(DateHeure, "%Y-%m-%d"), 
         year = year(DateHeure),
         hour8 =  floor(hour(DateHeure) / 8) * 8, # creates a 2-hours interval
         DateHeure = NULL) %>% group_by(hour8,day,year) # group galabre_time by hour
nrow_hour8 <- n_groups(galabre_group_hour8)

# get mean q
q_hour8 <- galabre_group_hour8 %>% select(c("hour8", "q_m3.s")) %>% summarize_all(list("q_mean" = mean, "q_sd" = sd)) %>% ungroup() # mean of Q for each hour8


# creates matrix for MES
galabre_mes_hour8 <- galabre_group_hour8 %>% select(c("hour8", "mes_for_fit")) %>% summarize("list_mes" = list(mes_for_fit)) %>% ungroup() # creates a list of mes for each hour8

list_mes_hour8 <- galabre_mes_hour8$list_mes
mes_hour8_random <- future_replicate(nrow_boot, vapply(list_mes_hour8, 
                                                function(x) sample(x,1), numeric(1)),
                              future.seed = T) %>% 
                    t() # matrix of mes: one random sample per hour8, replicated 1000 times

mes_hour8_noise <- matrix(rnorm(nrow_boot*nrow_hour8, mean = 0, sd = mes_u), nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_hour8) 
mes_mat_hour8 <- mes_hour8_random * (1 + mes_hour8_noise) # final value of mes, with noise

mes_mean <- colMeans(mes_mat_hour8)

# Prediction matrix
mu_hour8 <- f(mes_mat_hour8, coefs_boot[,"a"], coefs_boot[,"b"], coefs_boot[,"aspt"])


# Prediction matrix, with noise
noise_mat_hour8 <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_galabre)
sigma_mat_hour8 <- sigma_gnls * abs(mu_hour8)^theta

noise_mat_hour8 <- matrix(rnorm(nrow_boot*nrow_hour8, mean = 0, sd = 1), nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_hour8)
noise_mat_hour8 <- noise_mat_hour8*sigma_mat_hour8

pred_hour8 <- mu_hour8 + noise_mat_hour8
pred_hour8 <- pmin(pmax(pred_hour8, 0), 100) # clampe pred_nls pour éviter les intervalles de prédiction en dessous de zéro


## computes prediction interval 
pi_hour8 <- t(
  apply(pred_hour8, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = T)
)

colnames(pi_hour8) <- c("lower", "upper")

boot_pred_hour8 <- colMeans(pred_hour8, na.rm = T)

## insert in galabre_hour8
galabre_hour8 <- q_hour8 %>% mutate(
                          mes_for_fit = mes_mean, # keep name for "fitting model"predict" function
                          poc_boot_pred = boot_pred_hour8,
                          poc_pred_lower = pi_hour8[,"lower"],
                          poc_pred_upper = pi_hour8[,"upper"],
                          aspt = aspt_value)

galabre_hour8$poc_fitted <- predict(pocfitg, galabre_hour8)

# variance 
galabre_hour8$poc_var_mean <- apply(mu_hour8, 2, var) # variance of fit parameters + MES 
galabre_hour8$poc_var_tot <- apply(pred_hour8, 2, var) # total variance per prediction, for prediction total uncertainty


# plot

ggplot(galabre_hour8, aes(x = mes_for_fit))+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_pred_lower, ymax = poc_pred_upper), col = "gray50")+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_pred_upper), col = "gray50")+
  geom_point(aes(y = poc_fitted, col = "fitted with all events"), size = 2)+
  geom_point(aes(y = poc_boot_pred, col ="poc_boot_pred"), alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkblue","lightblue"))+
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept = aspt_value, col = "darkred")+
  annotate(geom = "label", label = formula_pocfitg, x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1)+
  labs(x = "MES, g/L", y = "POC %", colour = "", shape = "", title = "POC predicted from MES, random sampling every 8 hour", subtitle = "Prediction interval in grey")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

```

```{r annual-flux-hour8, cache.lazy= F}

# creates matrix for Q

q_hour8_mean <-  matrix(q_hour8$q_mean, nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_hour8, byrow = T)
q_noise <- matrix(rnorm(nrow_boot*nrow_hour8, mean = 0, sd = q_u), nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_hour8) # creates a noise in percent (proportion), between 0 and 10%
q_mat_hour8 <- q_hour8_mean * (1 + q_noise) # final MC of q, with noise. SD NOT INCLUDED: will not always be available


# compute flux
flux_kg.s_mat_hour8 <- pred_hour8*mes_mat_hour8*1e-6*q_mat_hour8*1e-2*60*60*8 #pred_hour8 * mes_mat : poc in mg/L converted to ton; q_mat converted from m3/s to L/s. Period : nb of seconds in 1 hour8. 

# Get index for columns by year
index_years <- sapply(unique(galabre_hour8$year), function(y){which(galabre_hour8$year == y)}) # list of indices corresponding to each year

# annual flux
annual_flux_ton.y_hour8 <- sapply(index_years, function(idx){apply(flux_kg.s_mat_hour8[,idx], 1, sum, na.rm = T)}) # sum of fluxes per year, for each iteration of the bootstrap. Result is a matrix with nrow_boot rows and 19 columns (1 per year)

annual_flux_hour8_pi <- apply(annual_flux_ton.y_hour8, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = T) # confidence interval for annual fluxes, per year. 3 lignes, 19 columns
annual_flux_hour8_mean <- colMeans(annual_flux_ton.y_hour8, na.rm = T) # mean annual flux per year. 1 vector

annual_flux_hour8_sd <- apply(annual_flux_ton.y_hour8, 2, sd, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of annual flux per year. Is just an estimate of goodness of mean, not as good as than the confidence interval. 
 

annual_flux_hour8_df <- data.frame(year = unique(galabre_hour8$year), 
                        annual_flux_mean = annual_flux_hour8_mean, 
                        annual_flux_variability = annual_flux_hour8_sd,

interannual_flux_ton.y_hour8 <- rowMeans(annual_flux_ton.y_hour8, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux per iteration of the bootstrap
interannual_flux_pi_hour8 <- quantile(interannual_flux_ton.y_hour8, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = T) # prediction interval
interannual_flux_mean_hour8 <- mean(interannual_flux_ton.y_hour8, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux
interannual_flux_variability_hour8 <- sd(annual_flux_hour8_mean, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of interannual flux per year

interannual_flux_hour8_df <- data.frame(year = "interannual", annual_flux_mean = interannual_flux_mean_hour8, 
                                  annual_flux_variability = interannual_flux_variability_hour8,
                        annual_flux_pi_lower = interannual_flux_pi_hour8[1], 
                        annual_flux_pi_upper = interannual_flux_pi_hour8[3])

total_flux_hour8_df <- rbind(annual_flux_hour8_df, interannual_flux_hour8_df)
total_flux_hour8_df$group <- c(rep("annual", length(unique(galabre_hour8$year))), "interannual")

ggplot()+
  geom_col(data = total_flux_hour8_df, 
           aes(x=year, y = annual_flux_mean, fill = group))+
  geom_errorbar(data = total_flux_hour8_df, 
                aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_pi_lower, ymax = annual_flux_pi_upper, col = "prediction interval"),
                width = 0.3, size = 0.8)+
  geom_errorbar(data = filter(total_flux_hour8_df, year == "interannual"), 
                aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_mean - annual_flux_variability, 
                    ymax = annual_flux_mean + annual_flux_variability, col = "interannual variability"),
                width = 0.2, size = 0.8, linetype = 2)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("annual" = "lightblue", "interannual" = "indianred"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("prediction interval" = "darkblue", "interannual variability" = "darkred"), name = "")+
   labs(x = "Year", y = "Flux, from 4-hourly mean values (ton/year)", fill = "")+
```

```{r annual-flux-day2, cache.lazy=F}
annual_flux_day2_sd <- apply(annual_flux_ton.y_day2, 2, sd, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of annual flux per year. Is just an estimate of goodness of mean, not as good as than the confidence interval. 
 

annual_flux_day2_df <- data.frame(year = unique(galabre_day2$year), 
                        annual_flux_mean = annual_flux_day2_mean, 
                        annual_flux_variability = annual_flux_day2_sd, 
                        annual_flux_pi_lower = annual_flux_day2_pi[1,], 
                        annual_flux_pi_upper = annual_flux_day2_pi[3,])

ggplot(annual_flux_day2_df)+
  geom_col(aes(x=year, y = annual_flux_day2_mean), fill = "lightblue")+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_pi_lower, ymax = annual_flux_pi_upper), width = 0.2)+
  labs(title = "Mean annual flux with prediction interval", subtitle = "Sampling grequency: day2", x = "", y = "Mean annual flux, ton")+
  theme_minimal()

interannual_flux_ton.y_day2 <- rowMeans(annual_flux_ton.y_day2, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux per iteration of the bootstrap
interannual_flux_pi_day2 <- quantile(interannual_flux_ton.y_day2, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = T) # prediction interval
interannual_flux_mean_day2 <- mean(interannual_flux_ton.y_day2, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux
interannual_flux_variability_day2 <- sd(annual_flux_day2_mean, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of interannual flux per year

interannual_flux_day2_df <- data.frame(year = "interannual", annual_flux_mean = interannual_flux_mean_day2, 
                                  annual_flux_variability = interannual_flux_variability_day2,
                        annual_flux_pi_lower = interannual_flux_pi_day2[1], 
                        annual_flux_pi_upper = interannual_flux_pi_day2[3])

total_flux_day2_df <- rbind(annual_flux_day2_df, interannual_flux_day2_df)
total_flux_day2_df$group <- c(rep("annual", length(unique(galabre_day2$year))), "interannual")

ggplot()+
  geom_col(data = total_flux_day2_df, aes(x=year, y = annual_flux_mean, fill = group))+
    geom_errorbar(data = total_flux_day2_df, aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_pi_lower, ymax = annual_flux_pi_upper, col = "prediction interval"), width = 0.3, size = 0.8)+
  geom_errorbar(data = filter(total_flux_day2_df, year == "interannual"), aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_mean - annual_flux_variability, ymax = annual_flux_mean + annual_flux_variability, col = "interannual variability"), width = 0.2, size = 0.8, linetype = 2)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("annual" = "lightblue", "interannual" = "indianred"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("prediction interval" = "darkblue", "interannual variability" = "darkred"), name = "")+
   labs(x = "Year", y = "Flux, from bi-dayly mean values (ton/year)", fill = "")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
```

## 4 days

```{r pred-galabre-gnls-day4, cache.lazy = F}
# prepare df
galabre_group_day4 <- galabre_time %>% mutate(day = as.Date(format(DateHeure, "%Y-%m-%d")), day4 = floor(as.numeric(day - min(day)) / 4), year = year(DateHeure), DateHeure = NULL) %>% group_by(day4,year) # group galabre_time by day
nrow_day4 <- n_groups(galabre_group_day4)

# get mean q
q_day4 <- galabre_group_day4 %>% select(c("day4", "q_m3.s")) %>% summarize_all(list("q_mean" = mean, "q_sd" = sd)) %>% ungroup() # mean of Q for each day4


# creates matrix for MES
galabre_mes_day4 <- galabre_group_day4 %>% select(c("day4", "mes_for_fit")) %>% summarize("list_mes" = list(mes_for_fit)) %>% ungroup() # creates a list of mes for each day4
mes_day4_random <- replicate(nrow_boot, sapply(galabre_mes_day4$list_mes, function(x) sample(x,1)))%>% t() # matrix of mes: one random sample per day4, replicated 1000 times
mes_day4_noise <- matrix(rnorm(nrow_boot*nrow_day4, mean = 0, sd = mes_u), nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_day4) 
mes_mat_day4 <- mes_day4_random * (1 + mes_day4_noise) # final value of mes, with noise

mes_mean <- colMeans(mes_mat_day4)

# Prediction matrix
mu_day4 <- f(mes_mat_day4, coefs_boot[,"a"], coefs_boot[,"b"], coefs_boot[,"aspt"])


# Prediction matrix, with noise
noise_mat_day4 <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_galabre)
sigma_mat_day4 <- sigma_gnls * abs(mu_day4)^theta

noise_mat_day4 <- matrix(rnorm(nrow_boot*nrow_day4, mean = 0, sd = 1), nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_day4)
noise_mat_day4 <- noise_mat_day4*sigma_mat_day4

pred_day4 <- mu_day4 + noise_mat_day4
pred_day4 <- pmin(pmax(pred_day4, 0), 100) # clampe pred_nls pour éviter les intervalles de prédiction en dessous de zéro


## computes prediction interval 
pi_day4 <- t(
  apply(pred_day4, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = T)
)

colnames(pi_day4) <- c("lower", "upper")

boot_pred_day4 <- colMeans(pred_day4, na.rm = T)

## insert in galabre_day4
galabre_day4 <- q_day4 %>% mutate(
                          mes_for_fit = mes_mean, # keep name for "fitting model"predict" function
                          poc_boot_pred = boot_pred_day4,
                          poc_pred_lower = pi_day4[,"lower"],
                          poc_pred_upper = pi_day4[,"upper"],
                          aspt = aspt_value)

galabre_day4$poc_fitted <- predict(pocfitg, galabre_day4)

# variance 
galabre_day4$poc_var_mean <- apply(mu_day4, 2, var) # variance of fit parameters + MES 
galabre_day4$poc_var_tot <- apply(pred_day4, 2, var) # total variance per prediction, for prediction total uncertainty


# plot

ggplot(galabre_day4, aes(x = mes_for_fit))+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_pred_lower, ymax = poc_pred_upper), col = "gray50")+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_pred_upper), col = "gray50")+
  geom_point(aes(y = poc_fitted, col = "fitted with all events"), size = 2)+
  geom_point(aes(y = poc_boot_pred, col ="poc_boot_pred"), alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkblue","lightblue"))+
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept = aspt_value, col = "darkred")+
  annotate(geom = "label", label = formula_pocfitg, x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1)+
  labs(x = "MES, g/L", y = "POC %", colour = "", shape = "", title = "POC predicted from MES, random sampling every 4 day", subtitle = "Prediction interval in grey")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

```

```{r annual-flux-day4, cache.lazy=F}

# creates matrix for Q

interannual_flux_mean_day4 <- mean(interannual_flux_ton.y_day4, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux
interannual_flux_variability_day4 <- sd(annual_flux_day4_mean, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of interannual flux per year

interannual_flux_day4_df <- data.frame(year = "interannual", annual_flux_mean = interannual_flux_mean_day4, 
                                  annual_flux_variability = interannual_flux_variability_day4,
                        annual_flux_pi_lower = interannual_flux_pi_day4[1], 
                        annual_flux_pi_upper = interannual_flux_pi_day4[3])

total_flux_day4_df$group <- c(rep("annual", length(unique(galabre_day4$year))), "interannual")

ggplot()+
  geom_col(data = total_flux_day4_df, aes(x=year, y = annual_flux_mean, fill = group))+
    geom_errorbar(data = total_flux_day4_df, aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_pi_lower, ymax = annual_flux_pi_upper, col = "prediction interval"), width = 0.3, size = 0.8)+
  geom_errorbar(data = filter(total_flux_day4_df, year == "interannual"), aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_mean - annual_flux_variability, ymax = annual_flux_mean + annual_flux_variability, col = "interannual variability"), width = 0.2, size = 0.8, linetype = 2)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("annual" = "lightblue", "interannual" = "indianred"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("prediction interval" = "darkblue", "interannual variability" = "darkred"), name = "")+
   labs(x = "Year", y = "Flux, from bi-dayly mean values (ton/year)", fill = "")+
```

```{r annual-flux-week2, cache.lazy=F}
flux_kg.s_mat_week2 <- pred_week2*mes_mat_week2*1e-6*q_mat_week2*1e-2*60*60*24*14 #pred_week2 * mes_mat : poc in mg/L converted to ton; q_mat converted from m3/s to L/s. Period : nb of seconds in 1 week2. 

# Get index for columns by year
index_years <- sapply(unique(galabre_week2$year), function(y){which(galabre_week2$year == y)}) # list of indices corresponding to each year

# annual flux
annual_flux_ton.y_week2 <- sapply(index_years, function(idx){apply(flux_kg.s_mat_week2[,idx], 1, sum, na.rm = T)}) # sum of fluxes per year, for each iteration of the bootstrap. Result is a matrix with nrow_boot rows and 19 columns (1 per year)

annual_flux_week2_pi <- apply(annual_flux_ton.y_week2, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = T) # confidence interval for annual fluxes, per year. 3 lignes, 19 columns
annual_flux_week2_mean <- colMeans(annual_flux_ton.y_week2, na.rm = T) # mean annual flux per year. 1 vector

annual_flux_week2_sd <- apply(annual_flux_ton.y_week2, 2, sd, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of annual flux per year. Is just an estimate of goodness of mean, not as good as than the confidence interval. 
 

annual_flux_week2_df <- data.frame(year = unique(galabre_week2$year), 
                        annual_flux_mean = annual_flux_week2_mean, 
                        annual_flux_variability = annual_flux_week2_sd, 
                        annual_flux_pi_lower = annual_flux_week2_pi[1,], 
                        annual_flux_pi_upper = annual_flux_week2_pi[3,])

interannual_flux_ton.y_week2 <- rowMeans(annual_flux_ton.y_week2, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux per iteration of the bootstrap
interannual_flux_pi_week2 <- quantile(interannual_flux_ton.y_week2, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = T) # prediction interval
interannual_flux_mean_week2 <- mean(interannual_flux_ton.y_week2, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux
interannual_flux_variability_week2 <- sd(annual_flux_week2_mean, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of interannual flux per year

interannual_flux_week2_df <- data.frame(year = "interannual", annual_flux_mean = interannual_flux_mean_week2, 
                                  annual_flux_variability = interannual_flux_variability_week2,
                        annual_flux_pi_lower = interannual_flux_pi_week2[1], 
                        annual_flux_pi_upper = interannual_flux_pi_week2[3])

total_flux_week2_df <- rbind(annual_flux_week2_df, interannual_flux_week2_df)
total_flux_week2_df$group <- c(rep("annual", length(unique(galabre_week2$year))), "interannual")

ggplot()+
  geom_col(data = total_flux_week2_df, aes(x=year, y = annual_flux_mean, fill = group))+
    geom_errorbar(data = total_flux_week2_df, aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_pi_lower, ymax = annual_flux_pi_upper, col = "prediction interval"), width = 0.3, size = 0.8)+
  geom_errorbar(data = filter(total_flux_week2_df, year == "interannual"), aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_mean - annual_flux_variability, ymax = annual_flux_mean + annual_flux_variability, col = "interannual variability"), width = 0.2, size = 0.8, linetype = 2)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("annual" = "lightblue", "interannual" = "indianred"))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("prediction interval" = "darkblue", "interannual variability" = "darkred"), name = "")+
   labs(x = "Year", y = "Flux, from week2ly mean values (ton/year)", fill = "")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Month

```{r pred-galabre-gnls-month, cache.lazy = F}
# prepare df
galabre_group_month <- galabre_time %>% mutate("month" = month(DateHeure), year = year(DateHeure), DateHeure = NULL) %>% group_by(month,year) # group galabre_time by month
nrow_month <- n_groups(galabre_group_month)

# get mean q
q_month <- galabre_group_month %>% select(c("month", "q_m3.s")) %>% summarize_all(list("q_mean" = mean, "q_sd" = sd)) %>% ungroup() # mean of Q for each month


# creates matrix for MES
galabre_mes_month <- galabre_group_month %>% select(c("month", "mes_for_fit")) %>% summarize("list_mes" = list(mes_for_fit)) %>% ungroup() # creates a list of mes for each month
mes_month_random <- replicate(nrow_boot, sapply(galabre_mes_month$list_mes, function(x) sample(x,1)))%>% t() # matrix of mes: one random sample per month, replicated 1000 times
mes_month_noise <- matrix(rnorm(nrow_boot*nrow_month, mean = 0, sd = mes_u), nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_month) 
mes_mat_month <- mes_month_random * (1 + mes_month_noise) # final value of mes, with noise

mes_mean <- colMeans(mes_mat_month)

# Prediction matrix
mu_month <- f(mes_mat_month, coefs_boot[,"a"], coefs_boot[,"b"], coefs_boot[,"aspt"])


# Prediction matrix, with noise
noise_mat_month <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_galabre)
sigma_mat_month <- sigma_gnls * abs(mu_month)^theta

noise_mat_month <- matrix(rnorm(nrow_boot*nrow_month, mean = 0, sd = 1), nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_month)
noise_mat_month <- noise_mat_month*sigma_mat_month

pred_month <- mu_month + noise_mat_month
pred_month <- pmin(pmax(pred_month, 0), 100) # clampe pred_nls pour éviter les intervalles de prédiction en dessous de zéro


## computes prediction interval 
pi_month <- t(
  apply(pred_month, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = T)
)

colnames(pi_month) <- c("lower", "upper")

boot_pred_month <- colMeans(pred_month, na.rm = T)

## insert in galabre_month
galabre_month <-q_month %>% mutate(
                          mes_for_fit = mes_mean, # keep name for "fitting model"predict" function
                          poc_boot_pred = boot_pred_month,
                          poc_pred_lower = pi_month[,"lower"],
                          poc_pred_upper = pi_month[,"upper"],
                          aspt = aspt_value)

galabre_month$poc_fitted <- predict(pocfitg, galabre_month)

# variance 
galabre_month$poc_var_mean <- apply(mu_month, 2, var) # variance of fit parameters + MES 
galabre_month$poc_var_tot <- apply(pred_month, 2, var) # total variance per prediction, for prediction total uncertainty


# plot

ggplot(galabre_month, aes(x = mes_for_fit))+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_pred_lower, ymax = poc_pred_upper), col = "gray50")+
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_pred_upper), col = "gray50")+
  geom_point(aes(y = poc_fitted, col = "fitted with all events"), size = 2)+
  geom_point(aes(y = poc_boot_pred, col ="poc_boot_pred"), alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkblue","lightblue"))+
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept = aspt_value, col = "darkred")+
  annotate(geom = "label", label = formula_pocfitg, x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1)+
  labs(x = "MES, g/L", y = "POC %", colour = "", shape = "", title = "POC predicted from MES, random sampling every month", subtitle = "Prediction interval in grey")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

```

```{r annual-flux-month, cache.lazy=F}

# creates matrix for Q

q_month_mean <-  matrix(q_month$q_mean, nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_month, byrow = T)
q_noise <- matrix(rnorm(nrow_boot*nrow_month, mean = 0, sd = q_u), nrow = nrow_boot, ncol = nrow_month) # creates a noise in percent (proportion), between 0 and 10%
q_mat_month <- q_month_mean * (1 + q_noise) # final MC of q, with noise. SD NOT INCLUDED: will not always be available


# compute flux
flux_kg.s_mat_month <- pred_month*mes_mat_month*1e-6*q_mat_month*1e-2*60*60*24*30 #pred_month * mes_mat : poc in mg/L converted to ton; q_mat converted from m3/s to L/s. Period : nb of seconds in 1 month. 

# Get index for columns by year

# annual flux

annual_flux_month_pi <- apply(annual_flux_ton.y_month, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = T) # confidence interval for annual fluxes, per year. 3 lignes, 19 columns

annual_flux_month_df <- data.frame(year = unique(galabre_month$year), 
                        annual_flux_mean = annual_flux_month_mean, 
                        annual_flux_variability = annual_flux_month_sd,

interannual_flux_mean_month <- mean(interannual_flux_ton.y_month, na.rm = T) # mean interannual flux
interannual_flux_variability_month <- sd(annual_flux_month_mean, na.rm = T) # standard deviation of interannual flux per year

interannual_flux_month_df <- data.frame(year = "interannual", annual_flux_mean = interannual_flux_mean_month, 
                                  annual_flux_variability = interannual_flux_variability_month,
                        annual_flux_pi_lower = interannual_flux_pi_month[1], 
                        annual_flux_pi_upper = interannual_flux_pi_month[3])

total_flux_month_df <- rbind(annual_flux_month_df, interannual_flux_month_df)
total_flux_month_df$group <- c(rep("annual", length(unique(galabre_month$year))), "interannual")

ggplot()+
  geom_col(data = total_flux_month_df, aes(x=year, y = annual_flux_mean, fill = group))+
    geom_errorbar(data = total_flux_month_df, aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_pi_lower, ymax = annual_flux_pi_upper, col = "prediction interval"), width = 0.3, size = 0.8)+
  geom_errorbar(data = filter(total_flux_month_df, year == "interannual"), aes(x = year, ymin = annual_flux_mean - annual_flux_variability, ymax = annual_flux_mean + annual_flux_variability, col = "interannual variability"), width = 0.2, size = 0.8, linetype = 2)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("annual" = "lightblue", "interannual" = "indianred"))+

   labs(x = "Year", y = "Flux, from monthly mean values (ton/year)", fill = "")+
```

```{r interannual-error-in-percent}
# relative error by Monte-Carlo world
error_hour2 <- (interannual_flux_ton.y_hour2 - interannual_flux_ton.y)/interannual_flux_ton.y * 100
error_hour2_pi <- quantile(error_hour2, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = T) # confidence interval for annual fluxes, per year. 3 lignes, 19 columns
error_hour2_mean <- mean(error_hour2)

error_hour4 <- (interannual_flux_ton.y_hour4 - interannual_flux_ton.y)/interannual_flux_ton.y * 100
error_hour4_pi <- quantile(error_hour4, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = T) # confidence interval for annual fluxes, per year. 3 lignes, 19 columns
error_hour4_mean <- mean(error_hour4)

error <- data.frame(time_step = factor(c("2hours","4hours","8hours","day","2days","4days","week","2weeks","month"), levels = c("2hours","4hours","8hours","day","2days","4days","week","2weeks","month")),
                    error = c(error_hour2_mean, error_hour4_mean, error_hour8_mean, error_day_mean, error_day2_mean, error_day4_mean, error_week_mean, error_week2_mean, error_month_mean),
                    pi_upr = c(error_hour2_pi[3], error_hour4_pi[3], error_hour8_pi[3], error_day_pi[3], error_day2_pi[3], error_day4_pi[3], error_week_pi[3], error_week2_pi[3], error_month_pi[3]),
                    pi_lwr = c(error_hour2_pi[1], error_hour4_pi[1], error_hour8_pi[1], error_day_pi[1], error_day2_pi[1], error_day4_pi[1], error_week_pi[1], error_week2_pi[1], error_month_pi[1])) 

ggplot(data=error, aes(x = time_step))+
```
